verdict.rationale: EFTPS is an online payment service that stores enrollment and payment-history data, so letting users choose where that data is stored is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any region or data-residency selection. The docs cover only scheduling, payment history, MFA via Login.gov/ID.me, and batch software.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
